old.name: Vin Jaune — the cathedral wine
old.label: WINE
old.hook: Savagnin · 6 yrs 3 mos under voile · 62 cl clavelin
old.text: Savagnin · 6 yrs 3 mos under voile · 62 cl clavelin EUR 35-90 / clavelin ESSENTIAL at table Dinner Grown on blue marls, made from Savagnin only, aged 6 years 3 months under a voile of yeast in a barrel left unfilled — bottled in a 62 cl clavelin , the volume that supposedly remains after evaporation. The voile is thinner than Sherry flor, lets a little oxygen through, thrives at lower minimum alcohol (~13 % vs 15–15.5 %). It produces sotolon (3-hydroxy-4,5-dimethyl-2(5H)-furanone, first isolated from fenugreek 1975) at 120–268 µg/L — the molecule of curry, walnut, maple syrup. Pair with the Bresse poularde + morels (the free glutamate amplifies sotolon) or 30-month Comté. Houses: Macle (Château-Chalon), Tissot (Arbois), Ganevat (Rotalier), Overnoy/Houillon (Pupillin), Domaine de la Pinte (Arbois). Where Château-Chalon · Arbois · L'Étoile · Côtes du Jura

old.name: Poulsard / Ploussard — the palest red in France
old.label: WINE
old.hook: Translucent, low tannin, high acid — serve at 12-14 °C
old.text: Translucent, low tannin, high acid — serve at 12-14 °C EUR 18-40 / bottle RECOMMENDED Lunch / Dinner Indigenous Jura red. Pale orange-ruby, low tannin, cherry-cranberry fruit, high acid. Pupillin is the world capital — local signage calls it la capitale mondiale du Ploussard . Pair with Morteau or Montbéliard sausage, or with Morbier. Serve lightly chilled. The Overnoy/Houillon expressions are the world reference; the Fruitière Vinicole de Pupillin pours an accessible village wine; Tissot Singulier on the entry side. Where Pupillin · Arbois

old.text: Arbois · Château-Chalon · Côtes du Jura · L'Étoile + Macvin · Crémant · Marc — — — Arbois (~800 ha, all styles, France's first AOC gazette 15 May 1936); Château-Chalon (~50 ha, Vin Jaune only, four communes); Côtes du Jura (the broad regional, all styles); L'Étoile (~83 ha, white only, named for star-shaped crinoid fossils); plus three product AOCs — Macvin, Crémant, Marc. old.hook: The canonical Château-Chalon · family settled 1850 · 8th gen 2025
old.text: The canonical Château-Chalon · family settled 1850 · 8th gen 2025 Family in Château-Chalon since 1850. Laurent Macle has run the estate since 1995 (7th gen); his daughter Carmen Macle joined in January 2025 as 8th gen. 12 ha: 8 ha Chardonnay in Côtes du Jura + 4 ha Savagnin in Château-Chalon. Visits by appointment only. The reference Vin Jaune house — wines of extraordinary purity and longevity. Château-Chalon declassified vintages: 1974, 1980, 1984, 2001. Where Château-Chalon (30 km east-north) Address Rue de la Roche, 39210 Château-Chalon Phone +33 3 84 85 21 85

old.name: Domaine Stéphane Tissot
old.label: WINE — BIODYNAMIC
old.text: 50 ha · Demeter biodynamic since 2004 · 30+ cuvées Bénédicte & Stéphane Tissot, 50 ha — one of the Jura's largest serious estates. Organic 1999, biodynamic Demeter 2004. Over 30 cuvées on blue and grey marls, limestone and clay — across all five principal Jura varieties. Practices sous-voile ageing for certain Savagnin and Chardonnay wines. Tissot vines surround Pasteur's experimental vineyard plot in Montigny-lès-Arsures — the same village. Where Montigny-lès-Arsures (Arbois) Address 39 Rue de Curon, 39600 Montigny-lès-Arsures Phone +33 3 84 66 08 27

old.name: Maison Pierre Overnoy / Emmanuel Houillon — Pupillin
old.label: WINE — NATURAL
old.hook: The natural-wine reference of the Jura · sulfur-free since 1984
old.text: The natural-wine reference of the Jura · sulfur-free since 1984 Pierre Overnoy embraced sulfur-free winemaking in 1984, earning the title "pope of natural wine." Emmanuel Houillon (Overnoy's protégé and son-in-law) took over running of the domaine in 2001, with Overnoy continuing in an advisory role. 6 ha, equally divided between Ploussard, Chardonnay, Savagnin. Certified biodynamic. Allocation-only. A Pupillin Ploussard from Overnoy/Houillon is among the most sought-after natural wines in the world. The village is opposite La Table du Grapiot ★. Where Pupillin Address 32 rue du Ploussard, 39600 Pupillin Phone +33 3 84 66 24 27
